decisions.reason: As a low-risk extension of the established floor-care range, it should be retained because there is no clear evidence of performance below aspiration and the growing firm can absorb short-term uncertainty.
This maintenance oil closely fits the firm's installed base and service logic, so boundedly rational management would keep it absent a clear shortfall versus expected results.
Because it complements oiled wood floors already served by the firm and no negative market signal is reported, it would likely be kept while management learns about demand.
The moisture-protection underlay strengthens the core flooring system offer and, with industry growth and organisational slack, there is little reason to redeploy resources yet.
This underlay foam is a related accessory that supports system sales, so management would typically continue it unless results clearly fell below aspiration, which is not indicated here.
The oak parquet floor is very close to the firm's main business and strategic direction, making retention the likely choice in the absence of evidence of underperformance.
